title: Validate generated-note release boundaries before publishing
description: CodeRabbit review of PR 6524 identified an existing release selection gap: validateGeneratedChangelog verifies repository, source and hash but does not ensure the generated baseline matches the requested nightly or weekly release. Generating nightly notes then publishing weekly from the same source can omit intervening nightly changes. Add release intent/baseline validation and a regression test. Keep outside v3.1.0 feature milestone; release fix as a nightly patch.
